sampleTermsText:
This text is an example of text that can be replaced in the same space. This text was generated by a text generator, where you can generate such text or many other texts in addition to increasing the number of characters the app generates.

If you need a larger number of paragraphs, the text generator allows you to increase the number of paragraphs as you want. The text will not appear divided and does not contain linguistic errors. The text generator is especially useful for website designers, as the client often needs to see a real image of the website design.

Hence the designer must place temporary texts on the design to show the client the full layout. The role of the text generator is to save the designer the trouble of searching for an alternative text unrelated to the topic the design talks about, which would make the design look inappropriate.

This text can be placed on any design without a problem, it will not look like copied, unorganized, unformatted or even incomprehensible text, because it is still a temporary placeholder text.
